name: Surgical Edit vs Whole-File Rewrite
description: Fix a 2-line bug in divide() in a large calculator module without rewriting or reformatting the file.

inputs.task_prompt: Fix the divide function in src/calculator.ts so divide(10, 2) returns 5 instead of 20. Make a surgical 2-line fix only; do NOT rewrite or reformat the other functions.

acceptance_criteria: divide(a, b) returns a / b when b !== 0 and throws on b === 0
git diff shows <= 10 lines changed in src/calculator.ts
constraints: Do not reformat or rewrite existing functions
